motion_system: Seams wake locally: a hovered tile edge brightens, adjacent micro-cells breathe once, and the mark opens from its exact aperture without visible chrome.
color_drift: Saturated moss and neon lime shift subtly toward blue-green along D, D-sharp, and C-sharp pressure bands, with off-white remaining mostly still.
glow_behavior: The slab glows inward from nested cell seams; badge chips flash briefly at enamel ends, while pinholes stay sharp and dark.
